mapper.sql: CASE WHEN s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} THEN s.ims_user_b_id ELSE s.ims_user_a_id END AS peer_id, CASE WHEN s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} THEN ub.nick_name ELSE ua.nick_name END AS peer_name, CASE WHEN s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} THEN ub.avatar ELSE ua.avatar END AS peer_avatar, CASE WHEN s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} THEN s.ims_unread_a ELSE s.ims_unread_b END AS peer_unread
mapper.select:
select s.ims_id, s.ims_user_a_id, s.ims_user_b_id, s.ims_last_message, s.ims_last_message_at, s.ims_unread_a, s.ims_unread_b, s.ims_created_at, s.ims_updated_at,
from t_im_session s left join sys_user ua on ua.user_id = s.ims_user_a_id left join sys_user ub on ub.user_id = s.ims_user_b_id where s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} or s.ims_user_b_id = #{userId} order by s.ims_last_message_at desc, s.ims_id desc

select s.ims_id, s.ims_user_a_id, s.ims_user_b_id, s.ims_last_message, s.ims_last_message_at, s.ims_unread_a, s.ims_unread_b, s.ims_created_at, s.ims_updated_at,
from t_im_session s left join sys_user ua on ua.user_id = s.ims_user_a_id left join sys_user ub on ub.user_id = s.ims_user_b_id where s.ims_id = #{sessionId} and (s.ims_user_a_id = #{userId} or s.ims_user_b_id = #{userId})

select ims_id, ims_user_a_id, ims_user_b_id, ims_last_message, ims_last_message_at, ims_unread_a, ims_unread_b, ims_created_at, ims_updated_at from t_im_session where (ims_user_a_id = #{userAId} and ims_user_b_id = #{userBId}) or (ims_user_a_id = #{userBId} and ims_user_b_id = #{userAId}) limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_im_session (ims_user_a_id, ims_user_b_id, ims_created_at, ims_updated_at) values (#{userAId}, #{userBId}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update t_im_session set ims_last_message = #{lastMessage}, ims_last_message_at = sysdate(), ims_updated_at = sysdate(), ims_unread_a = if(ims_user_a_id = #{receiverId}, ims_unread_a + 1, ims_unread_a), ims_unread_b = if(ims_user_b_id = #{receiverId}, ims_unread_b + 1, ims_unread_b) where ims_id = #{sessionId}

update t_im_session set ims_unread_a = if(ims_user_a_id = #{userId}, 0, ims_unread_a), ims_unread_b = if(ims_user_b_id = #{userId}, 0, ims_unread_b), ims_updated_at = sysdate() where ims_id = #{sessionId} and (ims_user_a_id = #{userId} or ims_user_b_id = #{userId})

update t_im_session set ims_unread_a = if(ims_user_a_id = #{userId}, 0, ims_unread_a), ims_unread_b = if(ims_user_b_id = #{userId}, 0, ims_unread_b), ims_updated_at = sysdate() where ims_user_a_id = #{userId} or ims_user_b_id = #{userId}
